observed_value: FX01 issue rows have blank principal_amount_usd and assert non-USD source par requiring FX conversion
anchor_value: Raw SOI table 5 shows the flagged debt par amounts in USD: Alorica 10,253,311; Del Real 516,200 and 8,517,298; Florida Marine 11,259,570; Hoffmaster 167,522 and 6,631,072

culprit_citations.quoted_text: Florida Marine Transporters, LLC | Term Loan B - 13.36 % (SOFR + 8.50 %, 2.00 % Floor) | 11,259,570 | 03/17/28 | 10,945,735 | 10,943,176

rationale: FX01 is premised on non-USD source par needing an explicit FX conversion. The raw schedule of investments for the six flagged debt rows is a USD-denominated Par Amount table: the first flagged debt row carries the dollar sign in the Par Amount/Amortized Cost/Fair Value columns, and the subsequent rows continue in the same column structure with numeric USD par amounts. The raw source therefore does not support the non-USD condition that triggered FX01.
